title: Unused tapes in an oracle source configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $C$ be a finite Turing machine over that alphabet, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For any configuration $c$ of $M$ on its $M.k+1$ work tapes, any Boolean side, and any host-tape index $j$ whose numerical value is at least $M.k+2$, the tape at $j$ in the associated oracle source configuration is blank at every integer position, and its head is at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite oracle Turing machine $M$ over Booleans
